blocks.content: Every concept in this course leads toward one goal. You are going to build Brick Breaker. If you have never played it, here is how it works.
You have a paddle. The ball is in play. Above you, rows of bricks are waiting.

items: Every time the ball hits a brick, it vanishes
Miss the ball and the game is over
Clear every brick and you win

blocks.content: Next, let's look at exactly what you will learn to make this happen.
